answer: Correlation penalties: the network compares the timing, wording and voting patterns of every account each epoch. Clusters that move in lockstep share one reward pool instead of each earning separately, so a farm of fake identities is like many tents around a single oasis drinking from the same well. The attacker pays for every extra account yet gains almost nothing, and the payout cools from a bright ember to glacier-slow until the copies diverge, which takes real, costly independent work.
